extraFacts.fact: Push-in (push-to-connect) fittings are commonly classed with plastic fittings under HS subheading 3917.40 when the body is plastic; the importer's customs broker has the final say.

faqs.q: What is the Dixon nylon and nickel-plated brass push-in female elbow used for?
faqs.a: The Dixon Nylon/Nickel-Plated Brass Push-In Female Elbow joins semi-rigid nylon, polyurethane or polyethylene tube to a female NPT port at a right angle, with no tools. It has a glass-filled nylon body, nickel-plated brass threads and a Buna-N D seal, in 8 part numbers.

faqs.q: How do I read the Dixon push-in elbow part number 30090414?
faqs.a: The last two digits give the female NPT size and the two before them the tube size: 30090414 is a 5/32" tube by 1/4" FNPT elbow, 30095311 is 1/8" tube by 1/8" FNPT and 30096218 is 1/2" tube by 3/8" FNPT. The same codes repeat on every row: 04 is 5/32", 56 is 1/4" and 60 is 3/8" tube; 11, 14 and 18 are the threads.

faqs.q: Which tube and thread sizes does the Dixon push-in female elbow come in?
faqs.a: There are 8 part numbers, from 1/8" tube by 1/8" FNPT (30095311) to 1/2" tube by 3/8" FNPT (30096218). Tube sizes are 5/32", 1/4", 5/16", 3/8" and 1/2", and the female NPT is 1/8", 1/4" or 3/8", so read the row for the pair you need.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right Dixon push-in elbow for my air line?
faqs.a: Choose by the tube outside diameter and the male NPT thread on the port: for example 30095614 is 1/4" tube by 1/4" FNPT, 30090814 is 5/16" tube by 1/4" FNPT and 30096014 is 3/8" tube by 1/4" FNPT. The tube must be semi-rigid nylon, polyurethane or polyethylene of the stated outside diameter.

faqs.q: What pressure, temperature and vacuum can the Dixon push-in elbow take?
faqs.a: The maker states 290 psi (20 bar), a temperature range of -4°F to +175°F and a vacuum of 28 in. Hg, about 99 percent vacuum. Those are the limits for the whole range, so stay inside them and tell us if the line runs hotter.

faqs.q: What is the Dixon push-in female elbow made of, and what seal does it use?
faqs.a: The body is black glass-filled nylon with nickel-plated brass threads, a polypropylene release button and a Buna-N D seal, and it is silicone free. Nitrile suits air and general oils, but ask us before using it on aggressive fluids.

faqs.q: Does the Dixon push-in elbow belong to a series or standard?
faqs.a: The listing names the Legris series for this elbow and gives no fitting standard; it describes the thread as NPT. It is a push-to-connect design that seals on the outside diameter of the tubing. If your project needs a certificate, say so in the enquiry and we ask the maker.

faqs.q: What does the Dixon push-in female elbow connect to?
faqs.a: The push-in end takes semi-rigid nylon, polyurethane or polyethylene tube, and the female NPT end screws onto a male NPT nipple or adapter. For other push-in styles see our [push-to-connect pneumatic fittings shelf](/c/push-to-connect-pneumatic-fittings); the [brass hose barbs shelf](/c/brass-hose-barbs) has clamped-hose ends.

faqs.q: How do I connect and release the Dixon push-in elbow?
faqs.a: Push the tube in to connect, with no tools, and to disconnect press the release ring towards the fitting and pull the tube out. The elbow is reusable, so it can be connected and released many times, and the body is orientable so the outlet can be positioned.

faqs.q: Dixon push-in elbow or Legris 90 degree elbow: how do I choose?
faqs.a: This Dixon elbow has a female NPT thread with nickel-plated brass and a nylon body, while the [Legris 90 degree elbows](/p/legris-90-degree-elbows) are all-nylon elbows with male and tube ends. Both are push-in styles in the Legris series, so pick by whether your port is male or female.

faqs.q: Where is the Dixon push-in elbow made, and can it be exported from Dubai?
faqs.a: The listing gives the United States as the country of origin. We export the Dixon push-in female elbow from Dubai, UAE to the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond, with the invoice and packing list prepared for your destination.

faqs.q: Do you keep the Dixon push-in female elbow in stock in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. The Dixon nylon push-in female elbow sits in our Dubai, UAE stock and goes out worldwide with the best lead times. For a quotation, send the part numbers (for example 30090414 or 30096218) and quantities via [our contact page](/contact).
